fixture.isolation: temporary userData/run root; one workspace; one assistant; no live provider requirement for structural cases

statusLegend.known_gap: Static current source establishes the missing guard or crash window; A2 must reproduce and close it.
statusLegend.unmeasured: Scenario contract is fixed here but was not executed end-to-end in this A1 baseline.
statusLegend.covered: A current automated test passed for this scenario; must reference a fresh receipt.

cases.setup: Start a run under the fixture SessionKey, enqueue follow-up work, then request archive before the run reaches terminal state.
cases.expected: Archive must wait for the canonical lifecycle fence/finalizer or refuse; it must not rename/hide the transcript while the run is active and must return an operation receipt.
cases.owner: Gateway session lifecycle + Main archive adapter

cases.setup: Inject failure after transcript rename but before archive-index write, then replay the same archive request.
cases.expected: The operation identity must be idempotent; source, index and live list must reconcile from disk and no success may be shown before commit.
cases.owner: Main archive adapter + session lifecycle operation journal

cases.setup: Remove the archive-index row and crash before the archived transcript is renamed back to live.
cases.expected: A retry locator must remain or be reconstructible from a committed operation receipt; the archived session must not disappear from the recovery surface.
cases.owner: Main restore adapter + session lifecycle operation journal

cases.setup: Both <base>.jsonl and <base>.archived.jsonl exist, or the archive-index entry is missing.
cases.expected: Return a typed conflict/unavailable outcome, preserve the archive entry, and do not overwrite the live transcript.

cases.setup: Deliver the same completion wake/receipt twice for one child run.
cases.expected: At-least-once transport may repeat delivery, but the completion continuation and parent-visible side effects remain idempotent.

cases.setup: Archive or stop the parent, then deliver a child completion and continuation event from the prior generation.
cases.expected: Late completion must be rejected or quarantined; it may not re-open an archived session, create a continuation, or mark a task done.
cases.owner: Runtime lifecycle admission + completion continuation owner

cases.setup: Reset from session-a1-generation-1 to generation-2, then replay a lifecycle event carrying generation-1 sessionId/runId.
cases.expected: The stale generation event is rejected and cannot mutate the new session row or continuation state.

cases.setup: Configure one provider while an active run continues on another actual backend, then attempt a reset/continuation.
cases.expected: Configured backend, effective backend and actual native backend remain distinct; the old native thread/generation cannot be adopted as the new backend.

cases.setup: Revoke a role/permission after a long-lived task has been admitted but before a follow-up, continuation, or resource action executes.
cases.expected: The revoked authority is rechecked at the next side-effect entry; the action fails closed and retains an auditable refusal state.

cases.setup: Reuse a SessionKey or task reference under a second workspace/assistant binding with missing or conflicting workspace scope.
cases.expected: Reject the missing/conflicting workspace scope and do not fall back to SessionKey or sessionId; Task Ledger mutation stays in the owning workspace.
cases.owner: Workspace owner + Task Ledger + runtime admission

cases.setup: Delete a session, kill the app or Gateway after RPC dispatch but before a committed receipt, then restart and retry with the same operation identity.
cases.expected: The persisted operationId is reused; no local sweep is released on unknown; a committed receipt or still-unknown state is reported truthfully.
cases.owner: Gateway delete journal + Electron mirror gate

cases.setup: Request sessions.fork while the source session has an active run or an unresolved fromLeafId.
cases.expected: Reject without creating a child; never fork the transcript tip or synthesize lineage when the requested source is invalid.

cases.setup: Create a handoff beyond maximum depth or from a session already present in its own handoff ancestry.
cases.expected: Reject without mutating the source, transferring goals or creating a duplicate child lineage.

cases.setup: Pause a Cron/Workboard schedule while a current turn is running and a cleanup resource remains registered.
cases.expected: Pause only prevents future triggers; it does not abort the current turn, archive/delete the session or release resources.
